query:
SELECT id AS "id!",
               twitch_login AS "twitch_login!",
               twitch_user_id AS "twitch_user_id?",
               status
          FROM twitch_partners
         WHERE LOWER(twitch_login) = LOWER($1)
         ORDER BY COALESCE(departnered_at, partnered_at, '') DESC, id DESC
         LIMIT 1
